name: taskcut
description: Compacts the conversation at sub-task boundaries instead of at the context limit. Once the context is past a floor, a small model judges at the end of each turn whether the work asked for is finished; if it is, taskcut replaces its working context with a ledger of what was asked and answered, keeping the human turns verbatim and spending no summarizer call. Below the floor it does nothing and costs nothing.

floorPercent.title: Compact above this context fill
floorPercent.description: Below this context fill taskcut does nothing at all: no model is asked and nothing is cut. A cut invalidates the prompt cache, and the kept set is re-cached at full price, measured at 12k-15k tokens, so it is only worth making once the window has actually filled. Set to 0 to judge every turn.

recentHumanTurns.title: Recent human turns kept verbatim
recentHumanTurns.description: Human turns are kept word for word, but they are unbounded on a long run. The turn that set the standing task is always kept; this is how many of the most recent ones are kept beside it.

ledgerVerbatim.title: Ledger entries kept verbatim
ledgerVerbatim.description: The ledger is the one thing a cut never shrinks. Past this many finished pieces of work the oldest are folded into a single rolled-up entry by one small-model call, made only when a cut happens.

model.title: Small model taskcut asks
model.description: Judges, at the end of a turn past the floor, whether the work asked for is finished, from the request and the answer alone; and folds the ledger. Alias or full id, resolved the way a --model value is.

outcome.title: Ask for a written conclusion
outcome.description: Off (default): the model's own answer for each piece of work is what the ledger keeps, and taskcut costs the working model nothing. On: once the context is past the floor, the model is offered a close_task tool and asked to write what the next sub-task needs; that costs output tokens and one request per call, and the tool stays available for the rest of the session.
